title: Collection pocket
idea: Collection pocket: Small visual records grouped by collection with a persistent search
audience: People who need to collect within a mobile surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its collect priority and explicit commitment contract: Deletion is reversible and synchronization explicit
navigation: Collection pocket keeps the current collect context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Small visual records grouped by collection with a persistent search
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to collect; people retrieve personal saved material
composition.priority: Deletion is reversible and synchronization explicit

imagery.role: Support the actual collect context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use one column with meaningful metadata when large text grows
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the collection pocket structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no collect content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Deletion is reversible and synchronization explicit
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized collect content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Deletion is reversible and synchronization explicit
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active collect context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
